name: Nicolette
source:
Captain of the Royal Guard

Though Nicolette is quick to boast that she's the strongest Captain in the entire Royal Guard, it's a title that none would claim she didn't earn. And despite her current position being one that most people would be more than happy with, to her it's nothing more than the final step towards her ultimate goal of becoming a Knight.

Tomboyish and foulmouthed, Nicolette doesn't exactly place much value on being "proper".
Fortunately, her brusque nature is mostly countered by her generally friendly disposition.
And while it may not be much of an issue when it comes to her job, it does pose concerns for certain relatives of hers who really wish that she'd be more ladylike.

But her parents and siblings wouldn't have her any other way.
